o.text: From Proto-Turkic *ȫrdek (“duck”). Cognate with Karakhanid اۥرْدَكْ (ördek), Turkish ördek, etc.
From tutu (“parrot”, from Classical Persian طُوطِی (tūtī)) + quşu (definite accusative of quş (“bird”))
Present participle compound of tən (“equal”) + böl- (“to divide”).
